recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless XPath-only SearchParameter definitions are reintroduced; future edits to these extension search parameters should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-31342 reported R4 package SearchParameter resources for CodeSystem, ValueSet, and Patient extension search parameters that had xpath expressions but no FHIRPath expression, and asked either to remove those draft parameters or add FHIRPath expressions.
initial_application: PR #2143 was applied in commit 5db7e943dfc9a252dac37ec83139206754e9dc95, adding FHIRPath expressions to the listed core XML SearchParameter source files. Later commit 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 removed XPath usage from those files.
additional_context: Current core source no longer contains the listed SearchParameter files; commit b7e37c11e1a1480180a2265381dac9c31e443ce1 deleted the draft extension SearchParameters from core, and fhir.ini records SearchParameter.xpath as removed. The corresponding maintained definitions are now in the FHIR Extension Pack, where the CodeSystem, ValueSet, and Patient search parameters each contain expression values and no xpath.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no core source correction is needed: the reported files are absent from current core, no current core SearchParameter source file has xpath without expression, and the extension-pack copies already have expressions.

related_jiras.note: The later registry-linking source commit deleted the draft extension SearchParameter files from core, explaining why current core has no source files to edit for FHIR-31342.
